name: startup-extracted
description: Issues #11/#17: fast supply-ramp startup transient for bandgap_top taken against a SWAPPABLE DUT netlist (sim/dut convention) rather than an embedded copy of the circuit -- the post-layout form of sim/startup/. Measures startup time against the ratified < 1 ms bound (README.md Target specification, Startup row). The startup branch's own residual supply current (sim/startup/'s iq_startup_branch_final_ua) is NOT measured here: it needs a series ammeter inside a bandgap_startup subcircuit instance, and a klt-extracted netlist is flat. det_final_v carries the disengagement evidence instead.
claim: README.md#target-specification (Startup row: self-starting at all corners incl. SS/-40C/2.97V, < 1 ms to within 1% of final value), re-substantiated post-layout against the parasitic-extracted netlist (#17). Measurement conventions are identical to sim/startup/'s so the two records are comparable line for line.
analyses:
let n = length(time)
let vf = v(vref)[n-1]
let iqf = -i(vsup)[n-1]*1e6
let detf = v(xtop.startup_det)[n-1]
let tol = 0.01 * abs(vf)
let lo = vf - tol
let hi = vf + tol
let idx = n-1
let inband = 1
while inband = 1 AND idx > 0
  if v(vref)[idx-1] < lo | v(vref)[idx-1] > hi
    let inband = 0
  else
    let idx = idx - 1
  end
end
let t_settle = time[idx]
let vdd_final = v(vdd)[n-1]
let thresh = 0.9*vdd_final
let j = 0
let above = 0
while above = 0 AND j < n-1
  if v(vdd)[j] >= thresh
    let above = 1
  else
    let j = j + 1
  end
end
let t0 = time[j]
let startup_time = t_settle - t0

startup_time_s.description: ratified spec: self-starting < 1 ms (README.md Target specification, Startup row). Measurement convention: t=0 is the time vdd crosses 90% of its final (PVT-point) value; settled is the last time v(vref) exits +/-1% of its OWN final simulated value at that PVT point (per the ratified spec's 'within 1% of final value' wording) -- computed as a genuine backward scan from the end of the run, so any late re-entry (chattering) after an earlier apparent settle pushes t_settle later rather than being missed. A negative value means the loop was already inside the 1% band before vdd even reached 90% of final (the best possible outcome for a slow ramp) -- see sim/startup-slow-ramp/.

vref_final_v.description: sanity window, same bound as sim/bandgap-loop-smoke/ (issue #8) -- an untrimmed, unsized-amp existence-proof bound, not the ratified +/-2% spec window; catches a gross convergence failure, not a spec-conformance claim (amp sizing is #10).

det_final_v.description: clean-disengagement sanity bound: the startup branch's detect node should sit well below nfet_03v3's Vth (0.53-0.89V over the full PVT matrix per design/device-characterization.md section 3) once the core is running, i.e. MKFB/MKCASC are firmly off, not partially conducting.
